component.name: IPTVPanel
component.script:
' -- Playlist URL ------------------------------------------------------------- CONST M3U_URL = "http://1tv41.icu:8080/get.php?username=3022207888&password=leonmatthews60@gmail.com&type=m3u"
CONST ROW_H = 40 CONST MAX_ROWS = 12 CONST LEFT_W = 280 ' group sidebar width CONST RIGHT_X = LEFT_W + 8
' colours CONST C_BG = "0x0D1117FF" CONST C_CARD = "0x161B22FF" CONST C_SEL = "0x238636FF" CONST C_TEXT = "0xE6EDF3FF" CONST C_SUB = "0x8B949EFF" CONST C_BORDER = "0x30363DFF" CONST C_BLUE = "0x58A6FFFF" CONST C_YELLOW = "0xD29922FF"
sub init() m.allChannels = [] m.groups = ["All"] m.groupIdx = 0 m.filteredChs = [] m.chOffset = 0 m.chCursor = 0 m.focusSide = "group" ' "group" or "channel" m.loaded = false
buildChrome()
m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "M3UTask") m.task.observeField("status", "onStatus") m.task.observeField("channels", "onChannels") end sub
' -- chrome ------------------------------------------------------------------ sub buildChrome() ' background bg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bg.translation = [0, 0] bg.width = 1280 bg.height = 596 bg.color = C_BG
' title bar tb = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") tb.translation = [36, 12] tb.width = 1208 tb.height = 40 tb.color = C_CARD
titleLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") titleLbl.translation = [52, 19] titleLbl.text = "[TV] LIVE TV - IPTV PLAYER" titleLbl.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" titleLbl.color = C_TEXT
m.statusLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.statusLbl.translation = [860, 23] m.statusLbl.text = "Press OK to load playlist" m.statusLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.statusLbl.color = C_SUB m.statusLbl.width = 380
' group sidebar sideBar = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") sideBar.translation = [36, 62] sideBar.width = LEFT_W sideBar.height = 520 sideBar.color = C_CARD
sideHdr = m.top.createChild("Label") sideHdr.translation = [48, 68] sideHdr.text = "GROUPS" sideHdr.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" sideHdr.color = C_BLUE
m.groupList = m.top.createChild("Group") m.groupList.translation = [36, 92]
' channel list area chArea = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") chArea.translation = [RIGHT_X + 36, 62] chArea.width = 1280 - RIGHT_X - 72 chArea.height = 520 chArea.color = C_CARD
chHdr = m.top.createChild("Label") chHdr.translation = [RIGHT_X + 52, 68] chHdr.text = "CHANNELS" chHdr.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" chHdr.color = C_BLUE
m.chCountLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.chCountLbl.translation = [900, 68] m.chCountLbl.text = "" m.chCountLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.chCountLbl.color = C_SUB
m.chList = m.top.createChild("Group") m.chList.translation = [RIGHT_X + 36, 92]
' now-playing bar at bottom npBg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") npBg.translation = [36, 566] npBg.width = 1208 npBg.height = 24 npBg.color = "0x0D1117FF"
m.nowPlayingLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.nowPlayingLbl.translation = [52, 569] m.nowPlayingLbl.text = "<> Switch pane ^v Navigate OK = Play * = Reload playlist" m.nowPlayingLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.nowPlayingLbl.color = C_SUB m.nowPlayingLbl.width = 1160 end sub
' -- load (called by MainScene) ----------------------------------------------- function load(args as Dynamic) if m.loaded then return invalid m.statusLbl.text = "* Loading playlist..." m.task.url = M3U_URL end function
' -- M3U task callbacks ------------------------------------------------------- sub onStatus() s = m.task.status if Left(s, 5) = "error" m.statusLbl.text = "X " + s m.statusLbl.color = "0xF85149FF" else if Left(s, 2) = "ok" parts = s.Tokenize(":") count = "?" if parts.count() >= 2 then count = parts[1].trim() m.statusLbl.text = "OK " + count + " channels loaded" m.statusLbl.color = "0x3FB950FF" m.loaded = true else m.statusLbl.text = s m.statusLbl.color = C_SUB end if end sub
sub onChannels() chs = m.task.channels if type(chs) <> "roArray" or chs.count() = 0 then return
m.allChannels = chs
' collect unique groups preserving order seen = {} m.groups = ["All"] for each ch in chs g = ch.group if g = "" then g = "Uncategorized" if not seen.doesExist(g) seen[g] = true m.groups.push(g) end if end for
m.groupIdx = 0 renderGroups() applyGroupFilter() end sub
' -- render group sidebar ----------------------------------------------------- sub renderGroups() while m.groupList.getChildCount() > 0 m.groupList.removeChildIndex(0) end while
maxGroups = 12 y = 0 for i = 0 to m.groups.count() - 1 if i >= maxGroups then exit for g = m.groups[i]
sel = (i = m.groupIdx) and m.focusSide = "group" active = (i = m.groupIdx)
rowBg = m.groupList.createChild("Rectangle") rowBg.translation = [0, y] rowBg.width = LEFT_W rowBg.height = ROW_H - 2 if sel then rowBg.color = C_SEL else if active then rowBg.color = "0x21262DFF" else rowBg.color = C_BG
lbl = m.groupList.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [14, y + 10] lbl.text = g lbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" if active then lbl.color = C_TEXT else lbl.color = C_SUB lbl.width = LEFT_W - 20 lbl.truncateOnDelimiter = "..."
y = y + ROW_H end for
if m.groups.count() > maxGroups more = m.groupList.createChild("Label") more.translation = [14, y + 6] more.text = "..." + str(m.groups.count() - maxGroups).trim() + " more" more.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" more.color = C_SUB end if end sub
' -- apply filter and render channel list ------------------------------------ sub applyGroupFilter() grp = m.groups[m.groupIdx] if grp = "All" m.filteredChs = m.allChannels else filtered = [] for each ch in m.allChannels g = ch.group if g = "" then g = "Uncategorized" if g = grp then filtered.push(ch) end for m.filteredChs = filtered end if
m.chOffset = 0 m.chCursor = 0 m.chCountLbl.text = str(m.filteredChs.count()).trim() + " ch" renderChannels() end sub
sub renderChannels() while m.chList.getChildCount() > 0 m.chList.removeChildIndex(0) end while
y = 0 endIdx = m.chOffset + MAX_ROWS - 1 if endIdx >= m.filteredChs.count() then endIdx = m.filteredChs.count() - 1
chW = 1280 - RIGHT_X - 80
for i = m.chOffset to endIdx ch = m.filteredChs[i] localI = i - m.chOffset
sel = (localI = m.chCursor) and m.focusSide = "channel"
rowBg = m.chList.createChild("Rectangle") rowBg.translation = [0, y] rowBg.width = chW rowBg.height = ROW_H - 2 if sel then rowBg.color = C_SEL else if i mod 2 = 0 then rowBg.color = C_BG else rowBg.color = "0x161B22FF"
' channel number numLbl = m.chList.createChild("Label") numLbl.translation = [10, y + 10] numLbl.text = str(i + 1).trim() numLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" numLbl.color = C_SUB numLbl.width = 60
' channel name nameLbl = m.chList.createChild("Label") nameLbl.translation = [74, y + 10] nameLbl.text = ch.name nameLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" if sel then nameLbl.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" else nameLbl.color = C_TEXT nameLbl.width = chW - 210 nameLbl.truncateOnDelimiter = "..."
' group tag (small) grpLbl = m.chList.createChild("Label") grpLbl.translation = [chW - 200, y + 10] grpLbl.text = ch.group grpLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" grpLbl.color = C_SUB grpLbl.width = 196 grpLbl.truncateOnDelimiter = "..."
y = y + ROW_H end for
if m.filteredChs.count() = 0 empty = m.chList.createChild("Label") empty.translation = [14, 16] empty.text = "No channels in this group." empty.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" empty.color = C_SUB end if
if m.filteredChs.count() > MAX_ROWS hint = m.chList.createChild("Label") hint.translation = [10, y + 6] hint.text = "^v scroll - " + str(m.filteredChs.count()).trim() + " total" hint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" hint.color = C_SUB end if end sub
' -- key handling ------------------------------------------------------------ function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false
if m.focusSide = "group" if key = "right" m.focusSide = "channel" renderGroups() renderChannels() return true else if key = "up" if m.groupIdx > 0 m.groupIdx = m.groupIdx - 1 renderGroups() applyGroupFilter() end if return true else if key = "down" if m.groupIdx < m.groups.count() - 1 m.groupIdx = m.groupIdx + 1 renderGroups() applyGroupFilter() end if return true else if key = "OK" m.focusSide = "channel" renderGroups() renderChannels() return true else if key = "replay" ' * = force reload m.loaded = false m.statusLbl.text = "* Reloading..." m.statusLbl.color = C_SUB m.task.url = M3U_URL return true end if
else ' focusSide = "channel" if key = "left" m.focusSide = "group" renderGroups() renderChannels() return true
else if key = "up" if m.chCursor > 0 m.chCursor = m.chCursor - 1 else if m.chOffset > 0 m.chOffset = m.chOffset - 1 m.chCursor = 0 end if renderChannels() return true
else if key = "down" if m.chCursor < MAX_ROWS - 1 and (m.chOffset + m.chCursor) < m.filteredChs.count() - 1 m.chCursor = m.chCursor + 1 else if m.chOffset + MAX_ROWS < m.filteredChs.count() m.chOffset = m.chOffset + 1 m.chCursor = MAX_ROWS - 1 end if renderChannels() return true
else if key = "OK" idx = m.chOffset + m.chCursor if idx >= 0 and idx < m.filteredChs.count() ch = m.filteredChs[idx] m.nowPlayingLbl.text = "> NOW PLAYING: " + ch.name m.nowPlayingLbl.color = "0x3FB950FF" m.top.selectedChannel = ch end if return true
else if key = "replay" ' * = reload m.loaded = false m.statusLbl.text = "* Reloading..." m.statusLbl.color = C_SUB m.task.url = M3U_URL return true end if end if
return false end function
